extracted.intended_audience: Prospective Hertz Fellowship applicants and their recommenders
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and help resources for preparing and submitting a Hertz Fellowship application, plus information and support for recommenders. Covers eligibility, timeline, recommendation letters, technical support, and fellowship benefits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application FAQ (requirements and process)
rubrics_metrics.description: Get answers to the most common questions about the Hertz Fellowship application requirements and process. You’ll find details on eligibility, the application timeline, and other key information to help you prepare your submission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as the primary resource for understanding what is required to apply and how to navigate the process; consult for eligibility rules, timeline milestones, and preparation tips.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who Can Apply / Eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: The nation’s most promising talent comes from different disciplines, backgrounds, and points of view.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See the full eligibility criteria (linked as 'see all criteria') to confirm whether you qualify before starting an application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guidance for Recommenders
rubrics_metrics.description: Access information to help write an effective letter of recommendation and make the most of this critical role in the application process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides recommenders with expectations and tips for composing letters that support an applicant’s candidacy; recommenders should review this guidance before submitting letters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Technical Support (recommendation process support)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have any additional questions or require technical assistance at any point during the recommendation process, please contact our Fellowship Team at fellowshipinfo@hertzfoundation.org.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the provided contact (fellowshipinfo@hertzfoundation.org) for troubleshooting submission issues or questions about recommender workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advice from Hertz Fellows (application craft guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: Gain valuable insights from in-school and career Hertz Fellows to help you better understand the fellowship program and craft a compelling application. They want you to apply!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Former and current fellows share practical tips and perspectives to strengthen applications; consult these testimonials/advice to improve statement, presentation, and fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fellowship Benefits (funding and duration)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Hertz Fellowship awards up to five years of funding, valued at up to $250,000—and so much more.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarizes the financial and programmatic support offered to recipients; useful for applicants to understand the award’s scope and incentives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career Support & Mentorship
rubrics_metrics.description: In addition to networking with some of the nation’s preeminent scientists, Fellows also work with a dedicated mentor throughout their fellowship.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights post-award mentorship and networking benefits that may be used to explain applicant fit and long-term impact in personal statements.
